name: game_state
description: Current game state. Transitioning to 'scheduled' requires game_schedule_start to be set.
validator: async (val) => { const opts = await this.options(); return opts.map(o => o.value).includes(val); }
options_resolver: ($) => [{ label: 'Idle', value: 'idle' }, { label: 'Scheduled', value: 'scheduled' }, { label: 'Running', value: 'running' }, { label: 'Paused', value: 'paused' }, { label: 'Ended', value: 'ended' }]

name: game_schedule_start
description: UTC timestamp (ms) for when the game auto-starts. Required before transitioning to 'scheduled'.

name: tasks_visible_on_pause
description: Allow players to view tasks and task groups while the game is paused.

name: max_team_size
description: Maximum number of members allowed in a single team (leader included).

name: allow_invites_during_game
description: Allow team leaders to generate invite codes while the game is running or paused.

name: allow_team_name_change_during_game
description: Allow team leaders to rename their team while the game is running or paused.

name: allow_name_change_during_game
description: Allow users to change their display name while the game is running or paused.

name: allow_member_deletion_during_game
description: Allow team leaders to remove members while the game is running or paused. Admins are never restricted.
